description: ACOSH(x) - inverse hyperbolic cosine, ln(x + sqrt(x*x - 1)): zero at 1, the known value at 2, an exact round trip through COSH, and NULL in / NULL out. Converted 1:1 from functions/AcoshTest (now retired); the Java class compared with a 1e-9 tolerance, which the testkit's 10-significant-figure normalisation supplies.
